items.title: 5.12 Bernoulli ke usool ke istemalat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.12 with Figs. 5.17 to 5.23 (PDF 109-112).

blocks.text: Bohat se aale us dabao ke farq se kaam karte hain jo fluid ki speed ki tabdeeliyon se paida hota hai.

items: Hawai jahaz ke par (Fig. 5.17): par yun banaya jata hai ke hawa ko mor de taake streamlines par ke oopar neeche ke muqable zyada qareeb hon. Jahan streamlines zyada qareeb majboor hon wahan speed tez hai, to hawa par ke oopar neeche se tez chalti hai; par ki choti par dabao kam hai, par oopar ki taraf dhakela jata hai, aur hawai jahaz ka lift isi asar se hai. (Par bahar gol aur andar chapte kyun hain? Muri oopar ki satah rasta lamba karti aur par ke oopar streamlines jama karti hai.)

Gend ka swing (Fig. 5.18): jab gend ko spin ke saath phenka ya thokar mari jaye to bowler gend ko ek taraf se zyada hamwar banata hai aur doosri taraf khurdari rehti hai. Hawa khurdare hisse par tez chalti hai aur hamwar par sust; Bernoulli ki equation se tez chalti hawa kam dabao banati hai jabke sust hawa zyada dabao, aur yeh dabao ka farq ek tarfa force, Magnus effect, paida karta hai jo gend ko hawa mein morta hai.

Filter pump (Fig. 5.19): filter pump ke darmiyan tangi hoti hai, to nal se pani ka jet wahan tez bahta hai. Is se us ke qareeb dabao girta hai aur hawa is liye side tube se andar aati hai; hawa aur pani mil kar pump ke neeche ke hisse se bahar nikalte hain.

Carburetor (Fig. 5.20): car engine ka carburetor cylinders ko hawa aur petrol ka sahih mixture dene ko Venturi duct istemal karta hai. Hawa duct se aur ek pipe ke saath cylinders tak kheenchi jati hai, aur duct ke kinare ek nanha inlet petrol se bhara jata hai. Duct se hawa bohat tez chalti hai, duct mein kam dabao banati hui, jo petrol ke bukharat hawa ki dhaar mein kheenchta hai.

Paint sprayer (Fig. 5.21): liquid mein doobi tube par se guzarti hawa ki dhaar liquid ko tube mein oopar uthati hai. Yeh asar perfume ki botlon aur paint sprayers mein istemal hota hai: jab atomizer ki rubber ki gend dabai jati hai to hawa tube se guzar kar tang munh se tez speed se nikalti hai, dabao ki kami paida karti hui, to hawa ka dabao perfume ko oopar tang munh tak dhakelta hai.
Venturi relation (Fig. 5.22): chaure section A1 aur tang section A2 wala ufqi pipe, jin ke dabao manometer milata hai; neeche akhz hai.
Torricelli ka theorem (Fig. 5.23): tank ke chhote soorakh se nikalne ki speed; neeche akhz hai.

blocks.text: Ek pipe lein jis mein density rho ka fluid cross-section ke mukhtalif raqbon se bahta hai (Fig. 5.22): chaure sire par A1 aur tang hisse par A2, flow speeds v1 aur v2 aur dabao P1 aur P2 ke saath jo manometer ki shakhein batati hain. Chunke pipe ufqi hai, ausat potential energy dono jagah ek si hai, to Bernoulli ki equation deti hai P1 + (1/2) rho v1^2 = P2 + (1/2) rho v2^2, ya P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho v2^2 - (1/2) rho v1^2, ya P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho (v2^2 - v1^2) ... (5.25). Equation of continuity se A1 v1 = A2 v2, v1 = A2 v2 / A1. Chunke A2, A1 ke muqable chhota hai, v1, v2 ke muqable chhoti hai: chaure hisse mein fluid tang hisse ke muqable bohat sust hai, to Eq. 5.25 ke daen hisse mein v1 nazar andaz ki ja sakti hai: P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho v2^2 ... (5.26). Yeh Venturi relation hai, jo Venturi meter mein istemal hoti hai, liquid ke bahao ki speed napne ka aala. Ufqi pipe ke liye Bernoulli ki equation se saaf hai ke jahan speed zyada ho wahan dabao kam hoga: P + (1/2) rho v^2 = mustaqil (Interesting Information).

Bernoulli ki equation ka saada istemal: farz karein fluid ke bare tank mein do chhote soorakh A aur B hain (Fig. 5.23). Soorakh A se pani nikalne ki speed nikalne ko: chunke soorakh bohat chhote hain, nikalne ki speeds v2 aur v3 pani ki oopar ki satah ki speed v1 se bohat bari hain, to v1 taqreeban sifr li ja sakti hai. Bernoulli ki equation phir P1 + rho g h1 = P2 + (1/2) rho v2^2 + rho g h2 hai; magar P1 = P2 = hawa ka dabao, to v2 = sqrt(2 g (h1 - h2)) ... (5.27). Yeh Torricelli ka theorem hai: nikalne (efflux) ki speed us velocity ke barabar hai jo fluid gravity ke tahat faasla (h1 - h2) girne mein hasil kare. Nikalne ki speed oonchai (h1 - h2) se girti gend ki speed jaisi hai: tank ki oopar ki satah thori neeche hui aur PE nikalne wale fluid ki KE mein muntaqil hui. Agar soorakh B par oopar ki taraf hota (print 'Fig. 6.4' ka hawala deta hai, jo is chapter mein nahi) to yeh KE liquid ko tank ke pani ki satah tak uthne deti; amal mein viscous-energy nuqsan nateeje ko kuch had tak badalte hain.

P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho v2^2 speed napta hai

blocks.prompt: Tank mein pani ki satah se 5 m neeche soorakh hai; nikalne ki speed nikalein (numerical 5.7). Tez chalti train ke qareeb khara hona khatarnak kyun hai, aur venturi mask kaise kaam karta hai (short question 5.9; MCQ 5.11)?
blocks.explanation: v = sqrt(2 g h) = sqrt(2 x 9.8 x 5) = 9.9 m s^-1. Train ke saath ghaseeti hawa tez chalti hai, to us ka dabao aap ke peechhe ki sakin hawa se kam hai, aur dabao ka farq aap ko train ki taraf dhakelta hai. Venturi mask mein tang jet se guzarti oxygen tez chal kar dabao ghatati hai, kamre ki hawa ka muqarrar hissa kheenchti hui: Bernoulli ka usool.

items: Tez fluid, kam dabao: par ka lift (oopar streamlines qareeb), ghoomti gend ka swing (Magnus effect), filter pump, carburetor (Venturi duct), paint sprayer aur atomizer.
Venturi: ufqi pipe, P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho (v2^2 - v1^2), v1 na-qabil-e-zikr ho to P1 - P2 = (1/2) rho v2^2 (Venturi meter). Torricelli: v2 = sqrt(2 g (h1 - h2)), gehrai se free-fall ki speed.
